scope: Ten newly verified pre-registered research sources. Exact registered URLs were readable; no new external sources.

verified_claims: Self-RAG trains a single language model to retrieve on demand and uses reflection tokens to control retrieval, generation and self-critique.
The paper reports factuality and citation-accuracy improvements on its open-domain QA, reasoning, fact-verification and long-form-generation experiments.
records.boundary: This is a particular training method, model scale and benchmark result, not a requirement that every RAG system use reflection tokens.

verified_claims: CRAG uses a lightweight retrieval evaluator to assess overall retrieved-document quality and select a knowledge-retrieval action by confidence.
It proposes decomposing and recomposing retrieved documents to focus salient information and filter irrelevant content.
records.boundary: The paper's web-search branch is not authorization to resume external search; results from its four evaluation sets are not production guarantees.

verified_claims: GraphRAG builds an entity knowledge graph from source documents and pre-generates community summaries.
For global questions it generates local answers from community summaries and reduces them to a final answer.
records.boundary: The paper evaluates global corpus-sensemaking questions; it does not prove graph retrieval dominates conventional retrieval or prescribe all graph construction details.

verified_claims: ColPali introduces the ViDoRe visual-document-retrieval benchmark and represents document-page images as multi-vectors for late-interaction retrieval.
records.boundary: Paper results on ViDoRe do not imply OCR, text indexing or structured parsing can be skipped generally.

verified_claims: QASC selects seed sentences by query-sentence cosine similarity, expands context windows and aggregates chunk scores.
It reports better results than selected static and semantic chunking baselines on 100 technical documents and 200 queries.
records.boundary: Study scale, query types, human evaluation and metrics constrain the conclusion; relative gains and thresholds are not universal settings.

verified_claims: DiskANN is an SSD-backed graph-based approximate-nearest-neighbor system that introduces the Vamana graph index.
The paper reports recall, latency and density trade-offs on SIFT1B using its specified 16-core, 64GB RAM and SSD environment.
records.boundary: Performance numbers depend on dataset, hardware, index parameters and measurements and are not general ANN or vector-database commitments.

verified_claims: IA-RAG represents facts as time intervals and applies Allen interval algebra to temporal constraints such as containment and overlap.
It proposes logical tightening for event subgraphs with incomplete temporal boundaries and evaluates temporal QA.
records.boundary: This is a temporal-reasoning research framework, not evidence that ordinary temporal metadata gives general RAG equivalent capability.

verified_claims: IRCoT alternates chain-of-thought sentence generation and retrieval in multi-step QA, using intermediate output to guide subsequent retrieval.
The paper reports retrieval and downstream QA improvements on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue and IIRC.
records.boundary: Applicable evidence is for multi-hop QA; generated reasoning and gains depend on the paper's model, prompts and datasets.

verified_claims: The paper defines score normalization as making document scores from component systems comparable and identifies it as a prerequisite for score-based fusion such as CombSUM and CombMNZ.
records.boundary: The accessible material supports only the score-comparability prerequisite; it does not establish any normalization method as universally optimal.

verified_claims: DynamicRAG uses LLM output quality as a reward to optimize a reranker with reinforcement learning and dynamically selects document order and count per query.
The paper evaluates the method on seven knowledge-intensive datasets.
records.boundary: Reported same-scale results depend on reward, reader, training and evaluation data; dynamic top-k is not generally guaranteed.
